scope: One prescribed-state native energy/work audit toward the remaining analytical gate; no equilibrium solve or product change
question: Does finite-mesh chord/shear energy explain the coarse reference discrepancy, or is there a resolved native energy-force/load-work inconsistency?

inputs.manufactured_state: Independent lambda=1-zbar*k and k=pi/6, no fitted or equilibrated state

method: Native element energy versus actual force-work contractions, independent chord/shear model, fixed fourth-order h and h/2 energy derivatives, independent terminal load work 0 and L*B*k

outcomes.consistent: Retain physical equations; choose a prospective refinement pilot based on measured components, without claiming convergence
outcomes.resolved_mismatch: Identify the specific force/energy/load term before adopting any repair
outcomes.inconclusive_or_timeout: Preserve partial evidence and stop this audit; no automatic variant or FE solve

interpretation_guards: A manufactured state represents a coupled trace only when its unchanged MPC constraint checks pass
Closed-model versus native-energy mismatch alone is not proof of a source defect
Finite-difference uncertainty must be reported separately; unresolved comparisons are not failures of mechanics
No source, load, material, reference, tolerance or public API change
No new full Astra-high review and no commit, push, release or external qualification
